radar_rotation_on_close._desc_enabled: Trigger coin rotation upon auto-closer liquidation to 100% cash. Default false in combat mode.
radar_rotation_on_close._desc_min_universe_age_hours: Minimum continuous runtime (23.0h) since start or last rotation before allowing rotation.
radar_rotation_on_close._desc_target_coins_count: Target number of active coins in strategy pool.
radar_rotation_on_close._desc_min_score_lead_pct: Hysteresis threshold (+35%): candidate replaces worst coin only if score is at least 35% higher.

fixed_net._desc: Mode 3: Direct flat basket take without trailing pullback. All positions liquidate to 100% cash when iter_net >= target_net_usdt.
fixed_net._desc_target_net_usdt: Fixed target net profit of iteration in USDT.
fixed_net._desc_scale_by_invest_size: If true, target scales as (invest_size / quant_reference_size) * target_net_usdt.

toxicity_adaptive._desc: Mode 2: Dynamic adaptive take based on inventory toxicity score. Liquidates basket on bounce to clean net profit.
toxicity_adaptive._desc_score_weights: Score method weights: margin load 35%, grid depth 30%, float loss ratio 25%, delta recovery 15%. Sum = 1.0.
toxicity_adaptive._desc_emergency_exit_floor_usdt: Minimum guaranteed profit on panic inventory (S >= 0.70). Loss close is prohibited.

trailing_ratchet._desc: Mode 1: Reacting skeleton. Pure Fibonacci ladder levels L0..L5. Triggers trailing stop and closes basket on pullback to floor.

_available_suffixes_doc: Available auto-closer mode suffixes: __off (no auto-closer), __classic (pure Fibo trailing), __fixed (flat net take), __toxic (institutional dynamic exit)

volatility_scanner._desc_strict_window: Strict history length requirement: exclude young listings with fewer candles than window.
volatility_scanner._desc_min_dayly_vol_usdt: Base liquidity filter: minimum 24h trading volume in USDT.

atr_volatility_filter._desc_window: Number of candles for volatility averaging.

bollinger_width_filter._desc_timeframe: Candle timeframe for Bollinger Bands calculation.
bollinger_width_filter._desc_MA_type: Moving average type: SMA or EMA.

center_proximity_filter._desc_enabled: Center proximity sub-filter: ensures entry from a balanced zone.
center_proximity_filter._desc_max_deviation_from_center_pct: Maximum price deviation from middleBB in % of channel width.
center_proximity_filter._comment: 50% = price at channel boundary, 75% = price within 1.5x half-width from center.

backup._desc_enabled: Informational toggle: background interval zip spam is deprecated. Runtime is continuously saved to atomic .pkl. When enabled, bot prints informational reminders for On-Demand backup service.

_on_demand_backup_service.format: JSON (sanitized runtime state with all positions and FSM)
_on_demand_backup_service._info_on_enabled_true: When enabled=true, bot prints reminders for /backup and CLI export.

risk_system._desc_min_balance_threshold_usdt: Global risk handbrake: minimum balance threshold in USDT. If cur_balance_usdt falls below this, bot liquidates all positions at market, pauses and alerts Telegram. null = disabled.

trade_velocity._desc_min_accumulation_hours: Minimum history accumulation time in hours before sending alerts.
trade_velocity._desc_benchmark_trades_per_coin: Benchmark number of trades per coin for specified timeframe_hours.
trade_velocity._desc_top_coins_slice: Coin slice: null for all coins (recommended), or integer N for top N coins.
